workflow.content_utf8:
name: Property capabilities editable WinUI release size

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      candidate:
        description: 'Candidate commit (complete original-workload PGO rebuild)'
        default: 'c686b70c60d87e0f0726de7dc60dc6fc1f123c48'
        required: true
        type: string
      reference:
        description: 'Reference commit (same consumer path, toolchain and policy)'
        default: 'dc93a16d88c8d8e6aedaa852f1106a856ab5993b'
        required: true
        type: string
  # Updating this frozen source pair starts its reviewed comparison. Ordinary
  # source/tooling pushes on the PR branch do not launch these expensive builds.
  push:
    branches: ['perf/compact-xaml-theme-codegen']
    paths: ['.github/workflows/winui-property-capabilities-release-size.yml']

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # Different frozen source pairs use independent runners and evidence roots.
  # Serialize repeats of one pair without cancelling another measured cohort.
  group: winui-property-capabilities-release-size-${{ github.ref }}-${{ inputs.reference || 'dc93a16d88c8d8e6aedaa852f1106a856ab5993b' }}-${{ inputs.candidate || 'c686b70c60d87e0f0726de7dc60dc6fc1f123c48' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release-comparison:
    name: Two complete editable releases and correctness evidence
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: never
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Native build and archive dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential binutils curl xz-utils pkg-config libfontconfig1-dev libfreetype6-dev
      - name: Rebuild, collect and validate both revisions sequentially
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REVISION: ${{ inputs.candidate || 'c686b70c60d87e0f0726de7dc60dc6fc1f123c48' }}
          REFERENCE_REVISION: ${{ inputs.reference || 'dc93a16d88c8d8e6aedaa852f1106a856ab5993b' }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/themes/bench/run_winui_release_comparison.py \
            --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
            --work-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/winui-property-capabilities-release-comparison" \
            --candidate "$CANDIDATE_REVISION" \
            --reference "$REFERENCE_REVISION"
      - name: Preserve complete results, inputs and failure evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: winui-property-capabilities-release-comparison-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/winui-property-capabilities-release-comparison/evidence
          # Only retained source/results are uploaded; Cargo credentials and
          # mutable caches live outside this evidence directory.
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 1
          retention-days: 14
